topic: Updating data sources for dashboard visualization
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical steps required to make newly processed data available for dashboard visualization. Initial issues included the inability to delete or truncate data in a distributed table (`device_session_agg_ml_vlad`). The solution involved running specific DDL statements (ALTER TABLE and TRUNCATE TABLE) on the sharded version.

To display the results on a dashboard, it was determined that updating the dataset's name and refreshing the cache were necessary steps. A complex SQL filter condition was provided to correctly select data based on the aggregation version (`agg_version`) and specific company/facility combinations, replacing previous date-based filtering.

Finally, the speaker ran an updated script which included adding June data into the database, ensuring a more comprehensive dataset for dashboard viewing.
decisions: The distributed table `device_session_agg_ml_vlad` requires specific DDL statements (ALTER TABLE and TRUNCATE) to clear old data.
Data visualization on the dashboard requires updating the dataset name and running a cache reload command.
The filtering logic for the dashboard must be updated to use company/facility numbers linked to the aggregation version, replacing previous date-based filters.
action_items: Run the provided script using one's own login credentials to test data ingestion.
Implement the revised SQL filter condition in the dashboard dataset definition.
